answer: Each new agent identity must lock escrow that stays frozen for thirty epochs, and the required lock doubles for every extra identity sharing one funding source, traced like saffron threads through a nebula of transfers. An honest agent posts once and later recovers its stake. A Sybil farmer spinning up a thousand onyx-dark clones must freeze a thousand escalating locks, and correlated voting slashes them all, so fake scale costs more than the rewards it could steal.
